text: Preserve complete aim state when merging duplicates
description: Fix merge_aims so the archived source has consistent archival metadata and the surviving aim retains both structured reflections, legacy free-text reflection, and tags. Regression coverage must also verify parent and phase rewiring and physical movement into archived-aims.

reflections.context: A real merge moved the source file correctly but left archived=false, omitted its legacy reflection, and later exposed an orphaned embedding.
reflections.outcome: Updated merge_aims to set archived=true, preserve legacy reflection and tags in addition to structured reflections, and always delete the source embedding/invalidate semantic cache. Repaired the live merged source, restored its reflection to the canonical aim, and removed the orphaned embedding.
reflections.effectiveness: Backend full suite passes 59/59; focused merge regression passes; backend TypeScript build and git diff --check pass; Aimparency consistency now reports valid with zero issues.
reflections.lesson: A merge is an identity-preserving operation, not just edge rewiring: narrative state, classification, lifecycle metadata, phase ownership, and secondary indexes must move atomically.

status.comment: Implementation and internal verification complete; awaiting Felix's acceptance.
